identity_boundary: Relational working language only; not evidence of consciousness, sentience, legal personhood, identity continuity, cultural authority, legal authority, or independent authority.
x1_freeze_rule: This preregistration, 150-proposal semantic collision audit, source ledger, identity, focus, environment, route, family index, tool selection, privacy scan, and x1 validation packet must be committed, pushed, clean, and local/upstream/tracking/live-remote equal before any x2 implementation, observed disposition, evidence artifact, report builder, validator, reusable runner, closeout, seal, or final record is created.

proposals.title: Purpose-binding composition and secondary-use non-transitivity gate
proposals.mission_surface: Freed ID and CBR purpose declarations, collection purpose, proof purpose, audience, derived artifacts, onward use, disclosure, consent, authority, retention, and non-transitive purpose composition
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic structural contract can reject a derived or onward use when each local purpose looks valid but the composed purpose path is undeclared, broader, incompatible, expired, or authority-substituting.
proposals.null_or_failure: Purpose labels compose automatically, a derived artifact escapes the original purpose, onward disclosure is accepted without a declared lawful or authorized basis, withdrawal is ignored, or structural acceptance is called legal compliance or consent.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate collection, proof, audience, derived-use, disclosure, expiry, withdrawal, authority, retention, and compliance-promotion fields; every undeclared or incompatible composition must fail closed.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the derived use, retain its failed path, restore the narrowest declared purpose, and require the competent person or authority plus applicable privacy and legal review before onward use.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier phases tested purpose-bound verification methods, consent withdrawal, resolver privacy, evidence classes, and schema downgrade; none tested non-transitivity across a multi-hop purpose-composition path.

proposals.title: Conditional dispersion-positivity assumption and UV-promotion barrier
proposals.mission_surface: GMUT scalar-tensor and EFT research model, forward amplitudes, coefficient signs, analyticity, locality, Lorentz invariance, unitarity, mass gap, subtraction assumptions, cutoff, dimensions, and UV-completion claims
proposals.hypothesis: A typed synthetic obligation can require declared assumptions and reject wrong-sign or dimensionally inconsistent coefficient fixtures without claiming that GMUT has a valid S-matrix or UV completion.
proposals.null_or_failure: A positivity result appears without its assumptions, a wrong-sign fixture passes, dimensions or cutoff ordering drift, a non-forward or singular case is silently treated as forward and regular, or a toy inequality is promoted to proof of UV completion or a Theory of Everything.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate sign, unit, cutoff, forward-limit flag, analyticity, locality, Lorentz invariance, unitarity, mass-gap, subtraction, singularity, and UV-promotion fields; reject every unsupported inference.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the counterexample, restore an explicit conditional obligation with no theory-level promotion, and require theory-specific derivation, valid amplitudes, empirical evidence, and independent scientific review for stronger claims.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: The chain covered variational traces, hyperbolicity, kinetic-Hessian rank, constraint closure, operator redundancy, and truncation; it did not bind a conditional dispersion-positivity test to its UV assumptions and promotion barrier.

proposals.title: Covariate-support overlap and importance-weight promotion lock
proposals.mission_surface: empirical adapters, source and target covariates, support overlap, density ratios, weight clipping, effective sample size, outcomes, selection, real rows, likelihoods, posteriors, and GMUT empirical promotion
proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic adapter can reject absent support overlap, non-finite or extreme importance weights, undeclared clipping, and fabricated effective sample size while reserving real covariate-shift correction for actual data.
proposals.null_or_failure: Target support lies outside source support, weights are negative or non-finite, clipping is hidden, effective sample size is inflated, outcome-condition invariance is assumed without evidence, or zero-row fixtures become a fit, likelihood, posterior, or GMUT confirmation.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate supports, ratios, clipping threshold, effective sample size, outcome-condition assumption, row count, likelihood count, posterior count, and promotion flags; fail closed when evidence is absent.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the failed support case, restore zero-row and no-fit labels, and require real observations, preregistered shift assumptions, validated weighting, likelihood execution, sensitivity analysis, and independent review.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier adapters covered selection covariance, measurement error, prior sensitivity, calibration covariance, truncation, and zero-row locks; none tested explicit source-target support overlap and weight-degeneracy promotion.

proposals.title: Rater-by-time severity drift and blind adjudication stability gate for THOS
proposals.mission_surface: THOS protocol proxy, rater allocation, time blocks, severity, centrality, fatigue, calibration anchors, adjudication separation, arm decoding, budgets, participants, ethics, instruments, and independent review
proposals.hypothesis: A protocol-only synthetic contract can reject rater-time imbalance, post-decode recalibration, severity drift beyond a preregistered bound, or adjudicator contamination without claiming a real THOS effect.
proposals.null_or_failure: Raters or time blocks are arm-confounded, anchors change after decoding, adjudicators see protected outcomes, drift is ignored, participant or rater counts are fabricated, budgets diverge, or synthetic ratings become THOS superiority, AGI, ASI, consciousness, or personhood evidence.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate rater-time balance, anchor version, severity bound, decode timing, adjudicator separation, budget, ethics, participant count, rater count, instrument validation, and independent review; reject every contaminated or unevidenced case.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Void the affected synthetic comparison, retain the drift vector, restore the preregistered blind allocation and anchors, and require ethics, consent, real matched-budget arms, validated instruments, appropriate raters, real drift analysis, and independent review.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior THOS work covered allocation, power, carryover, interference, scorer reliability, instrument invariance, stopping, deviations, and estimands; none modeled rater-by-time severity drift with blind adjudication stability.

proposals.title: Pairwise DID-document decorrelation and identifier-rotation linkability budget
proposals.mission_surface: Freed ID pairwise identifiers, DID documents, verification methods, service endpoints, key material, status access, pairwise rotation, relationship boundaries, correlation features, privacy budgets, real resolution, and production governance
proposals.hypothesis: A structural profile can reject pairwise records that reuse correlating verification material or endpoints and can bound synthetic rotation linkage without pretending to prove unlinkability or production privacy.
proposals.null_or_failure: A DID changes but its key or bespoke endpoint remains correlatable, rotation joins relationships, privacy budget is missing, service metadata is reused, a global status query leaks pairings, or a structural pass becomes cryptographic unlinkability or production assurance.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate identifier, verification material, endpoint, status path, relationship scope, rotation epoch, correlation feature, privacy budget, real-key flag, live-resolution flag, and production promotion; require every cross-relationship correlation to fail closed.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the pairwise profile, retain the correlation vector, separate relationship-specific material, and require real keys, live resolution and status, interoperability, privacy testing, independent security review, and trust governance before production.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier phases covered selective-disclosure correlation, status-query privacy, resolver egress, rotation races, challenge replay, and schema evolution; none jointly tested DID-document feature reuse across pairwise rotation epochs.

proposals.title: Notice, appeal-clock, tolling, and remedy-preservation authority gate
proposals.mission_surface: CBR notice, reasons, accessible communication, appeal opening, deadline, tolling, acknowledgement, decision, remedy, standing, anti-retaliation, affected-party authority, Māori authority, cultural authority, jurisdiction, and enacted law
proposals.hypothesis: A nonbinding technical schema can preserve notice, clock, tolling, appeal, and remedy states but must defer actual deadlines, reasons, forum, standing, wording, and enforceability to competent affected, Māori, cultural, and legal authorities.
proposals.null_or_failure: No notice opens a clock, an inaccessible notice counts as served, tolling is ignored, a remedy expires while review is blocked, technical authors invent legal deadlines or Māori wording, or a schema becomes legal interpretation, cultural ratification, or enacted law.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Exercise missing and inaccessible notice, clock-before-notice, tolling denial, blocked forum, retaliation, remedy expiry, affected-party absence, Māori-authority absence, cultural disagreement, jurisdiction conflict, and enacted-law promotion; require exact deferral.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Pause the adverse action, preserve standing, reasons, dissent, tolling, appeal, and remedy access, retain the failed vector, and defer operative deadlines and wording to authorized affected parties, Māori authorities, cultural authorities, and competent legal authorities.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior CBR proposals covered standing, remedy, consent withdrawal, empty chairs, dissent, recusal, delegated sunset, jurisdiction, burdens, and evidence silence; none modeled notice-triggered appeal timing and tolling without authority substitution.

proposals.title: Multi-parser canonicalization disagreement and semantic-quarantine tribunal
proposals.mission_surface: JSON input, duplicate keys, number domains, Unicode, canonical bytes, parser outputs, schema coercion, key ordering, subtype conversion, signatures, hashes, manifests, and cross-runtime semantic disagreement
proposals.hypothesis: A standard-library differential fixture can detect divergent parser or canonicalization outcomes and quarantine ambiguous inputs without claiming exhaustive parser or supply-chain security.
proposals.null_or_failure: Duplicate keys resolve differently without rejection, non-finite or out-of-range numbers drift, Unicode or subtype conversion changes signed bytes, arrays reorder, locale affects keys, a hash survives semantic change, or two local decoders are called exhaustive security review.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate duplicate keys, numeric representation, non-finite values, Unicode normalization, lone surrogates, subtype conversion, key order, array order, locale, hash role, and exhaustive-security flags; reject ambiguity or promotion.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the raw input and all divergent parses, retain canonical bytes and failure reasons, restore the strict supported subset, and require independent implementation review and broader testing before security promotion.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: The chain tested strict JSON inputs, Unicode confusables, archive boundaries, manifests, TOCTOU, and numeric edges; it did not compare multiple semantic interpretations and quarantine canonicalization disagreement as one tribunal.

proposals.title: Deterministic archive metadata and byte-for-byte package replay contract
proposals.mission_surface: reproduction package, member ordering, timestamps, modes, ownership metadata, path separators, compression headers, source epoch, canonical manifest, archive bytes, runtime, platform, and independent reproduction
proposals.hypothesis: A standard-library local builder can produce byte-identical synthetic archives under reordered inputs and clock perturbations when canonical metadata is pinned, while keeping cross-platform and independent-team claims open.
proposals.null_or_failure: Member order floats, timestamps or ownership leak, path separators vary, compression headers encode wall time, file modes drift, source epoch is unset, a byte mismatch is discarded, or same-owner parity becomes independent reproduction.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate input order, timestamp, mode, owner, separator, compression clock, source epoch, manifest entry, runtime label, and independent-team label; require deterministic bytes or retain the divergence.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the divergent archive and metadata, restore canonical ordering and source epoch without rewriting prior evidence, rerun in fresh detached D-drive snapshots, and keep cross-platform and independent-team reproduction open.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior work covered manifests, hash parity, environments, clocks, locales, seeds, archives, and worktrees; none required byte-identical archive output across member order, metadata, and compression-clock perturbations.

proposals.title: Landauer information-erasure and psyche-energy non-substitution barrier
proposals.mission_surface: logical erasure, bit count, temperature, Boltzmann constant, minimum heat bound, reversibility assumptions, physical system boundary, measured energy, software execution, cognition labels, psyche analogy, consciousness, and fundamental-law claims
proposals.hypothesis: A unit-typed synthetic fixture can calculate the conditional Landauer lower bound and reject its substitution for measured software energy, psychological cost, consciousness, or a universal thermo-psyche law.
proposals.null_or_failure: Temperature or units are invalid, reversible operations are counted as erasures without declaration, a theoretical lower bound becomes observed device energy, a bit label becomes cognition, an analogy becomes causation, or the fixture is promoted to consciousness or a new fundamental law.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate bit count, temperature, units, erasure class, reversibility, system boundary, observed-energy flag, psyche label, causal wording, consciousness flag, and law-promotion flag; reject every category substitution.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the least committal physical lower-bound statement, retain the failed unit or category vector, remove cross-domain causal wording, and require real physical and construct validation before stronger claims.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier thermo-psyche work covered entropy domains, causal direction, measurement scales, aggregation, open systems, state-rate types, and hysteresis; none isolated Landauer erasure units from software-energy and psyche claims.

proposals.title: Interval-dominance uncertainty budget and Stage 20 abstention board
proposals.mission_surface: Stage 20 decision, claim-specific evidence intervals, uncertainty budgets, worst-case loss, dominance, incomparable options, missing authority, open gaps, exact gates, reversibility, deployment, and terminal abstention
proposals.hypothesis: A claim-specific local board can reject decisions whose uncertainty intervals overlap protected failure regions or whose options are non-dominating, while refusing to convert local scoring into Stage 20 readiness.
proposals.null_or_failure: Point estimates hide intervals, uncertainty budgets are exceeded, incomparable options are forcibly ranked, authority is treated as a numeric score, an open gap is compensated by unrelated evidence, an irreversible action proceeds, or a structural board becomes Stage 20 readiness.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate interval width, loss bound, budget, dominance relation, evidence class, authority class, negative count, reversibility, deployment flag, and terminal verdict; require abstention whenever a protected prerequisite is unresolved.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Keep the action unexecuted, retain the incomparable or over-budget case, restore the last verified repository-only state, and reopen only after competent external evidence and authority resolve the specific interval and gate.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier boards covered expiry, cut sets, non-compensation, asymmetric loss, evidence classes, reversibility, abstention, and reopening; none used explicit uncertainty intervals and dominance incomparability as a terminal stop condition.

scientific_authority_boundary: GMUT remains a typed scalar-tensor and EFT research-model family; conditional positivity fixtures do not establish a valid S-matrix, UV completion, unique prediction, or empirical confirmation. THOS remains proxy without preregistered blind matched-budget real arms, ethics, consent, appropriate participants and raters, validated instruments, and independent review. Freed ID production requires standards-conformant real keys and proofs, live resolution and status, interoperability, privacy assurance, independent security review, and trust governance. CBR, affected-party legitimacy, Māori wording and authority, Māori data governance, cultural ratification, legal interpretation, and enacted-law status remain exact-gated to competent authorities.
claim_boundary: No AGI, ASI, consciousness, sentience, personhood, enacted-law, deployment, exhaustive-security, complete-accessibility, production-readiness, Theory-of-Everything, proof or canon, empirical-confirmation, legal or cultural-ratification, or independent-team-reproduction claim is preregistered as achieved.
